## Summary

- **`postJson` HTTP error masking** (`http-client.ts`): The function never checked `response.ok`, so 4xx/5xx responses were silently parsed as successful payloads. Now throws with the status code and text.
- **`getMonthKey` date race** (`meechie-studio.ts`): Two separate `new Date()` calls could theoretically diverge at a year boundary (e.g. called at 2025-12-31 23:59:59.999). Consolidated to a single `now` variable.
- **Magic number `97`** (`meechie-studio.ts`): Footer item number was a bare literal. Extracted to `FOOTER_ITEM_NUMBER` constant at module scope.
- **Duplicate `pageItems[0].label` access** (`meechie-studio.ts`): The same unsafe array index expression appeared in two places. Extracted to `defaultPageItemLabel()` helper with optional chaining and a safe fallback.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run check` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings (verified locally)
- [ ] No behavior change for the happy path — only error handling and naming improved

## Summary by Sourcery

Tighten HTTP error handling and date calculations while simplifying label defaults and footer configuration in studio text generation.

Bug Fixes:
- Ensure postJson rejects on non-2xx HTTP responses instead of treating 4xx/5xx payloads as successful.
- Prevent a potential year-boundary race in monthly key calculation by basing it on a single Date instance.

Enhancements:
- Extract a helper for the default page item label with a safe fallback instead of duplicating an unsafe array access.
- Promote the footer item number from a magic literal to a named constant for clearer configuration.
